description: Source code for a calendar widget (DHTML Calendar version 1.0) including constructor, utility functions, event handlers, and date manipulation methods.

classes.name: Calendar
classes.description: Main calendar object constructor with methods for creating, displaying, and managing a date picker widget.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates the calendar DOM structure inside a parent element.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the calendar to a specific date.

methods.name: setFirstDayOfWeek
methods.description: Changes the first day of the week.

methods.name: setDateStatusHandler
methods.description: Sets a function to determine disabled dates.

methods.name: callHandler
methods.description: Calls the user-defined handler for date selection.

methods.name: callCloseHandler
methods.description: Calls the handler for closing the calendar.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the calendar from DOM and cleans up.

methods.name: reparent
methods.description: Moves the calendar DOM element to a new parent.
